name: Kimikare
source:
Takishima Hina is an ordinary high school girl attending a private school, Chiba Academy. She enters the second year of her school life, but she is bored of her average routine. One day, a mysterious creature suddenly breaks into school! At the same time, Hina is confessed to by popular boys of the school and all these popular guys have secrets that they do not want to tell anyone... yet. What will happen to Hina's new school life?

[Edited from [url=http://madbonegames.blogspot.com/2012/11/kimikare-shingakki-psp-iso.html]Madbone Games[/url]]
translation:
泷岛雏是就读于私立千叶学园的普通女高中生。升入二年级后，她开始厌倦一成不变的日常。

某天，一个神秘生物突然闯入学校！与此同时，校内几名人气男生纷纷向雏告白，而这些男生都有暂时不愿让任何人知道的秘密……雏的新学期将会发生什么？

[改编自[url=http://madbonegames.blogspot.com/2012/11/kimikare-shingakki-psp-iso.html]Madbone Games[/url]]
